title: Good concept, but needs work (would have been four stars if lid snapped onto colander!)
text:
Good concept, but needs work (would have been four stars if lid snapped onto colander!). I own numerous OXO gadgets, many of which I wouldn't cook without. When I had the chance to review the 3-Piece Berry Bowl and Colander Set, I was excited. The 1.5-qt bowl has a nonslip bottom and all three parts are dishwasher safe. I used it to wash and presoak mung beans and fresh blackberries. For the mung beans, I stored them in the fridge overnight, and ran into the major design flaw: the lid is designed to snap onto the bowl, but only if the colander isn't inside. I had my mung beans sitting in the colander (in water) and the lid continually fell off when I would move it in the fridge. Likewise, if you have already rinsed fresh berries, you will want to store them in the colander to keep them from sitting in moisture. Also, my lid didn't fit the bowl; to make it snap on required a lot of contortion and hand strength, making it unfriendly for those with arthritis (which OXO products are marketed to). It was also extremely difficult to pry off once the lid was on the bowl. The bowl itself is smooth with no handles, so you'll find it hard to hang onto the slippery bowl and pry off the lid at the same time.

By making the lid so it doesn't fit the colander (the colander has handles that extend beyond the edge of the bowl to keep it from falling in), OXO has really decreased the potential utility of the design. Also, the OXO website states "The 3-Piece Berry Bowl & Colander Set is the perfect size for rinsing berries, quinoa, beans and more;" I agree that it is great for rinsing berries and beans, but rinsing quinoa would be a nightmare, as the holes in the colander are far too large to rinse quinoa without most of it ending up in the water (or down the drain).

If OXO would fix the lid design so that it would snap securly onto the colander, this would be a four-star product. Also, with the colander inserted, the storage is very small (even without the colander, it is too small to be used as an effective mixing bowl unless you're beating an egg or two).

Non-slip base stabilizes Bowl while mixing, even when tilted
Elevated ring under Colander provides on-countertop and in-sink stability
Colander features elongated holes for fast draining
Bowl, Colander and Lid nest for compact storage
description: The OXO Good Grips 3-Piece Berry Washing Bowl is the perfect size for rinsing berries, quinoa, beans and more. The Bowl features a non-slip bottom, while the two-tone design provides kitchen-to-table appeal. The Colander has an elevated ring along the bottom for added stability in the sink or on the countertop, as well as elongated holes for fast, efficient draining. The Lid seals the Bowl to keep food fresh, or rests on nested Bowl and Colander for simple storage. Bowl, Colander and Lid are dishwasher safe and BPA free.
